projects.title: LeadPilot App & Chrome Extension
projects.description: The Chrome extension automatically finds relevant LinkedIn posts, people, and companies based on keywords, collects their data, and sends it to the application via API. AI then filters valuable leads, verifies emails, and generates personalized outreach emails using profile and post data for higher engagement.

projects.title: AI WordPress Autoblog
projects.description: A custom WordPress plugin that automates AI-powered content creation and publishing. It researches topics, generates high-quality articles from keywords, finds relevant feature images, and adds useful internal and external links to create well-structured, SEO-friendly content.

projects.title: AI Website Assistant
projects.description: An AI-powered WordPress plugin that provides a smart website assistant using website and business information. It captures customer details and sends them by email, while saving new questions for review. Once a question is answered, the response is stored and automatically reused for future visitors asking the same question.

projects.title: AI Voice Receptionist
projects.description: An AI voice receptionist that responds to inbound calls, answers common questions, qualifies enquiries and coordinates meetings through calendar integrations.
